en: Black-and-white postcard showing a large rectangular manor or small castle set in open countryside. The building has three visible stories, a steep hipped roof with chimneys, many evenly spaced windows, and is surrounded by trees and fields. In the foreground there is a pasture and a simple wooden fence with tall trees framing the view. Printed captions in Swedish appear at the bottom, along with the photographer's credit and a serial number.
